[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Can my family visit?[/b][/color][color=white] Yes, at the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] camps, once a month, for a fee added to your balance.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I work off a relative’s debt?[/b][/color][color=white] Yes. Debts are transferable and inheritable.[/color]

[color=white][b]What happens when I finish?[/b][/color][color=white] Very few people ask this question. We will be happy to answer it when you do.[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]HOW COLLECTION WORKS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]After three missed payments, a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] recovery team will visit you to recover the asset. Implants are removed by certified technicians, usually in under ten minutes. If the asset cannot be recovered, the remaining debt becomes a work contract.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]THE GREAT COLLECTION, 2083[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Lockwell is proud to have recovered more than eleven million implants in a single year, restoring confidence to the credit market after the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF]OmniCredits Strike[/color][/url][color=white]. Former debtors who wish to forget the experience are offered a discount at the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF]Recall Clinic[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Everyone pays. Eventually." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][i]Grant Lockwell[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i], founder[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]WHAT IF I MOVE?[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]You can move anywhere in Los Vales: your Citizen ID is your account number. Leaving the country in debt is a crime, and since the Collection Convention of 2052 most countries collect Valian debts for the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white]. Lockwell Island has a sea view.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]WHAT IF I DO NOT READ MY NOTICES?[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Every notice is delivered to your Lens, and your Lens tells us when you open it. Notices that are not opened count as read.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"We never surprise a customer. We only arrive." — Lockwell recovery team motto[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]THE GENETIC RELIEF PROGRAM[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Heirs can erase half of an inherited balance with a single cheek swab. The sample is analyzed by our partners at [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Genesis Bio[/color][/url][color=white] for research that will one day benefit every Valian. The swab is painless. The research is confidential. The other half of the balance remains.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF9A3D][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]When does my debt expire?[/b][/color][color=white] It does not.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I declare bankruptcy?[/b][/color][color=white] Only the Republic ever did, in 2028. It became the Free States.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I refuse an inheritance?[/b][/color][color=white] You can refuse the house. You cannot refuse the debt.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who bought my debt?[/b][/color][color=white] Check your notices. The name at the top changes; the number does not.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"A debt is the only thing in Los Vales that lives forever. We just make sure it is looked after." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][i]Lockwell[/i][/color][/url]
